name: Arte Sema
source:
A blind woman who poses as a dancer at a local inn. She is actually a member of the Evil Secret Society the Four Heavenly Kings of Neobelaneed.
Arte is in charge of creating monsters for the organization, she is also known there as Dr. Arte, and is feared within the organization. In reality Arte can be quite selfish. She always has a kitten ([url=/c95053]Sophileno[/url]) with her.
